services.desc: Miami Night Boat Tour lovers instantly feel the magic of Miami after dark, where the skyline comes alive, the water glows with reflections, and the city transforms into a breathtaking nighttime paradise. This 90-minute Miami sightseeing night cruise glides smoothly across Biscayne Bay with open-air top-deck seating, a Mojito Bar, and a live tour guide sharing fun stories about celebrity homes and iconic landmarks. Perfect for couples seeking romance, families wanting a fun and safe adventure, and groups looking for the ultimate night sightseeing boat tour in Miami, this experience delivers unforgettable views and incredible nighttime energy.
